english.title: Zinge's Delivery
english.detail:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
english.objective: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
english.progress: You have something for me?
english.complete: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.

english.title: Sample for Helbrim
english.detail:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
english.objective: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
english.progress: You have a package for me?
english.complete:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, <name>.  Your reward is well earned.

english.title: Prompt Potion Runner
english.detail:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
english.objective: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
english.complete:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

english.title: The Weaver
english.detail:
An archmage of great power is overseeing the reactivation of the ley energy node. With the progress they have made, our only hope of stopping them is by killing him. It will be difficult, he is no doubt protected by many other mages and warders.

You must go, and you must dispatch him quickly. When he is dead, retrieve his staff for me. Go now.
english.objective: Kill the Dalaran archmage, then retrieve his staff for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Quickly, time runs short, <name>!
english.complete:
The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, <name>, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.

We must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.

english.title: Beren's Peril
english.detail:
I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.

I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
english.objective: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: Have you located their base yet, <name>? Time is of the essence!
english.complete: If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.

english.title: Assault on Fenris Isle
english.detail:
Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.

You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw.  I want his head!

This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, <name>.  You must not fail.
english.objective: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
english.progress: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, <name>.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
english.complete:
The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, <name>.  Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken.  Your value to us grows.

english.title: The Tortured Soul
english.detail:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
english.objective: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.
english.progress: <The offering stone is ominously still.>
english.complete:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>

english.title: The Offering of Blood
english.detail:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
english.objective: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>

english.title: Hamuul Runetotem
english.detail:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
english.objective: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem
english.complete: I bid you greetings, <name>.  You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength.  For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.

english.title: Nara Wildmane
english.detail:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.
english.objective: Speak with Nara Wildmane.
english.complete:
Yes, it is true.  I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns.  I have seen their twisted, scaled faces.  I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

You must stop them, <name>.

english.title: Leaders of the Fang
english.detail:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, <name>.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
english.objective: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, <name>.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
english.complete:
You have done it, <name>.  You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang.  My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.

I thank you, <name>.  I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.

english.title: Trouble at the Docks
english.detail:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
english.objective: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
english.progress:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
english.complete:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

english.title: Trouble at the Docks
english.objective: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz in Ratchet wants you to retrieve the bottle of 99-Year-Old Port from Mad Magglish who is hiding in the Wailing Caverns.
english.detail:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
english.progress:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
english.complete:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, <name>. Nicely done, I say!

english.title: Serpentbloom
english.detail:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, <name>. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
english.objective: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
english.progress: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
english.complete: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, <name>.

english.title: Deviate Hides
english.detail:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
english.objective: Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.
english.progress: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, <class>?
english.complete:
Your efforts shall not go unnoticed in gathering these hides, <name>.

Thank you for your dedication.

english.title: Deviate Eradication
english.detail:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, <name>, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
english.objective: Ebru in the Wailing Caverns wants you to kill 7 Deviate Ravagers, 7 Deviate Vipers, 7 Deviate Shamblers and 7 Deviate Dreadfangs.
english.progress:
<name>, we, the Disciples of Naralex, need your help. Our numbers are dwindling with our master trapped in his twisted nightmare. We have not the forces necessary to deal with the corrupt creatures which now haunt these caverns.

I beg of you, enter the caves and wage war on the deviate creatures!
english.complete:
As a Disciple of Naralex, I commend your bravery, <name>.

Your aid in ridding the caverns is the first step in our long plight to see the Barrens restored.

Thank you and may you prosper.

english.title: Smart Drinks
english.detail:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
english.objective: Bring 6 portions of Wailing Essence to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
english.progress: Where is my wailing essence?
english.complete:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, <name>.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!

english.title: Root Samples
english.detail:
The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands.  Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.

I want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!

If you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens.  Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
english.objective: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
english.progress: Hello, <name>.  Did you get those root samples?
english.complete:
Yes yes, these are very nice!  I will grow specimens from these roots and study them.  I hope to find new properties from them.  Hidden, valuable properties...!

And don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know.  Because I'll need someone to gather more!
